newsitem.title: USA: NiGas lifts natgas withdrawal limits.
newsitem.headline: NiGas lifts natgas withdrawal limits.

text.p: Northern Illinois Gas Co said Monday it lifted its "critical day" period, beginning with Tuesday natural gas deliveries.
From Saturday through Monday the company had limited natural gas storage withdrawals from its underground facilities due to severely cold temperatures in the region.
NiGas, a unit of NICOR Inc, has seven underground storage facilities throughout Illinois.
A critical day can be declared from November 1 to April 1 when storage withdrawals and supplies from NiGas based on contracted quantities need to be limited.
Any additional gas used by the customer was charged at $6.00 per therm plus the cost of the gas, the company said.
Chicago city-gate cash prices were talked around $3.95 per mmBtu, down from a high of $6.50 on Friday.
Temperatures in the region were expected to moderate Tuesday but then turn colder again later this week.
